observed_vs_expected: The expectation that best_target_score should rise or stabilize was not met; the metric fell from 0.6506 in round 2 to 0.5930 in round 3 (a lower deviation of ~0.0576). The tightest_margin held steady at 0.374 nm, showing no significant collapse.
deviation_mechanism: Tightening the Cr thickness bounds reduced the feasible design volume, inadvertently truncating the precise multi-layer interference conditions identified in round 2. Given the 13-layer stack's high spectral sensitivity, restricting the boundaries forced the optimizer into adjacent, broader parameter regions where quarter-wave phase matching is compromised, causing the transmission peak to collapse from the round 2 plateau back toward the baseline.
continue_rationale: Despite the performance rollback to 0.5929709309017381, the route maintains 9 valid candidates and a tightest_margin of 0.3744542348457307 nm, confirming the physics remains executable and unconstrained. insight_for_next: Relax the dielectric thickness bounds by 15% and initialize the next optimization run using the exact layer-by-layer thickness vector from round 2 as a baseline seed to directly re-exploit the recovered high-performance cluster.
